claim_boundary: This boundary records a ROADMAP-level AlphaEvolve source-span coverage matrix for all 55 PDF-verified named main-text sections, figures, tables, Appendix A/B spans, and named application sections, plus 833 bounded claim-level records across Table 1, Section 2, the Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, collaborator context, Section 3.1, Table 2, Figure 4, footnote 3, Section 3.2, Figure 5, the Section 3.3 opening, Section 3.3.1, Figure 6, Section 3.3.2, Figure 7, Section 3.3.3, Section 3.3.4, Section 4, Figure 8, and Section 5 Related Work, Appendix A, Table 3, and Figure 9. The Section 5 inventory separates 59 source-context-only literature claims from 26 implementation-relevant claims. The Appendix A inventory records 29 prose/caption claims, all 54 Table 3 rows, and 48 Figure 9 claims. The Appendix B inventory records 188 claims across all 13 subsections and Figures 10-14. It also records lexical source and bibliography linkage for all 195 TeX citation uses, 240 key links, and 120 compiled references without classifying supported propositions, source sufficiency, or implementation relevance. It also records construct-level dispositions for all 30 retained-source captions, displayed equations, and semantic footnotes, plus row- and cell-level dispositions for all 83 rows and 240 cells in Tables 1-3, without claiming sentence-, paragraph-, inline-math-, listing-, image-pixel-, or citation-level proposition exhaustiveness. It also records paper-status rows, and TODO/non-goal/phase proof. It does not claim whole-paper claim-level requirement exhaustiveness, a complete application-result claim matrix, status-row to ROADMAP disposition map, missing/partial TODO proof, non-goal decision map, phase-priority map, CI source-span exhaustiveness gate, or owner review signoff.
